exposure: mode of birth (vaginal delivery, caesarean section)
cohort: The study included 316 mothers who delivered at Adichunchanagiri Institute of Medical Sciences in B.G nagara.
finding: Mothers who underwent vaginal delivery had significantly higher LATCH scores compared to those who had a caesarean section, both at 1 hour and 24 hours post-birth.
mod_finding: Mothers who underwent vaginal delivery demonstrated higher LATCH scores and greater efficacy of latching compared to those who delivered by caesarean section.
